decision: The software-pipelined raw MMQ32 variant is bit-identical but measured neutral on the correctly fed (non-kmajor d4s4) raw owner: pipe 9.123 ms vs serial mb2 9.109 ms per 48-weight R24 pass (1.0015x, 22/48 wins). The initial 1.118x reading was a harness-layout artifact: both leaves first fed the kmajor source-layout activation buffer to all arms, slowing the serial mb2 arm (10.170 ms) relative to pipe (9.096 ms). The outer-floor reference check in the pipe contract test exposed the wrong feeding (KL ~46 vs reference), the producer was corrected, and the leaf rerun shows no retained win. The serial mb2 owner remains the registered default; the pipe and mb4 kernels remain exact diagnostics. The iter27 mb4-neutral conclusion was also measured under the wrong layout and is corrected: under the correct layout mb4 is 1.1164x SLOWER (10.170 vs 9.109 ms).
reopen_condition: A pipelining variant that wins on the correctly fed owner (leaf >=1.05x, 48/48, bit-exact) would reopen the default.

kmajor_layout_run.note: wrong producer layout; pipe-vs-serial bit-exactness still valid, timing invalid

timing: HIP events, consumer-only bursts (shared non-kmajor d4s4 producer excluded)
